# NeurusAGi — Full Site Summary for AI Agents

NeurusAGi (https://neurusagi.com) is an enterprise-grade artificial general intelligence (AGi) platform: advanced reasoning, compliance, and innovation for organizations. Tagline: "A Quantum Leap in Intelligence." Founder: Jeremy Taylor. Contact: jt@neurusagi.com.

## What is NeurusAGi?
NeurusAGi is the next evolution of artificial general intelligence: enterprise-grade AGi capabilities with advanced reasoning, compliance, and innovation.

- Pricing — https://neurusagi.com/pricing — plans for individuals, teams, and enterprise AGi deployments.

- Login — https://neurusagi.com/login ; Sign Up — https://neurusagi.com/signup (authentication required for /dashboard and /admin).
